name: Enthalpy v0.4.13
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.13

## Fixed

- Linux x64 AppImage: the published file now actually bundles libEGL.so.1 (and
  related GL/EGL libraries). Version 0.4.11 advertised this fix but the upload
  artifact had zero libEGL bytes because the release packaging used
  `wails3 generate appimage` and never ran the custom build.sh script. After
  checksum + chmod +x, the AppImage should open a window.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
